plan.title: Child Improvement Dashboard
plan.subtitle: Comparing baseline to endline performance by location and coach

panels.title: Total children tracked
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Child ID") AS n FROM baseline

panels.title: Average shuttle run improvement by location
panels.sql: SELECT "Location", AVG("Shuttle run sec"_end - "Shuttle run sec"_base) AS improvement FROM (SELECT b."Child ID", b."Location", b."Shuttle run sec" AS "Shuttle run sec"_base, e."Shuttle run sec" AS "Shuttle run sec"_end FROM baseline b JOIN endline e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID") GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Average sit-ups improvement by coach
panels.sql: SELECT "Coach", AVG("Sit ups"_end - "Sit ups"_base) AS improvement FROM (SELECT b."Coach", b."Child ID", b."Sit ups" AS "Sit ups"_base, e."Sit ups" AS "Sit ups"_end FROM baseline b JOIN endline e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID") GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Top 10 children with greatest shuttle run improvement
panels.sql: SELECT b."Child ID", b."Child name", (e."Shuttle run sec" - b."Shuttle run sec") AS improvement FROM baseline b JOIN endline e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" ORDER BY improvement DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: The dashboard shows {{p1}} children were tracked across locations and coaches. Average shuttle run improvements varied by location, with {{p2}} showing the most significant gains. Coaches like {{p3}} demonstrated strong performance in sit-ups improvement. The table highlights individual cases where children improved by over {{p4.improvement}} seconds in shuttle runs.
